liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dancin' In The Street** (2 reviews): The transition into Franklin's Tower features serious funk with Jerry and Brent locked in; The Dancin' In The Street to Franklin's Tower transition is a thirty-minute hoe-down [18][24]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): The second set contains monster jams, particularly in the He's Gone section [19]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Phil's drums in The Other One are huge and shake the walls [24]

## The recordings

- **gd1979-10-27.sbd.fix.miller.98561.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 182 min; rated 4.88/5 by 8 [1]
- **gd79-10-27.sbd.miller.29490.sbeok.flacf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 183 min; rated 4.5/5 by 20 [2]
- **gd1979-10-27.sbd.miller.29411.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 183 min; rated 4.5/5 by 6 [3]
- **gd1979-10-27.sbd.miller.98950.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 182 min; rated 4/5 by 14 [4]
- **gd79-10-27.sbd.clugston.13980.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 164 min; rated 4.6/5 by 48 [9]. Said about its sound: Splices occur in a crucial section of Dancin' In The Street; An audience splice during Dancin' provides a cool perspective before the soundboard returns [20][21]
- **gd79-10-27.aud-rolfe.warner.19416.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 20 songs; 167 min; rated 4.6/5 by 15 [12]. Said about its sound: The audience recording sounds fantastic, capturing magic and big bass that soundboards miss [22]

## Around the show

- The crowd on the floor sloshed back and forth, pushing listeners three or four feet [25]
- The venue was a sweatbox, but Dancin' In The Street hooked the listener [26]
- The venue was a minimalist New England hockey arena with all metal surfaces [28]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1979-10-27.sbd.fix.miller.98561.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony TCD5M/UDXL-II) -> Dat (Panasonic SV3800/48k) D [1]. Also: Nakamichi 700 to cassette master, then DAT and CD supplies Dancin' and The Other One [1]
- **gd79-10-27.sbd.miller.29490.sbeok.flacf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Soundboard [2]. Also: SBD to Sony TCD5M cassette, then Panasonic DAT; transferred and edited by Charlie Miller [2]
- **gd1979-10-27.sbd.miller.29411.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charles Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony TCD5M/UDXL-II) -> Dat (Panasonic SV3800/48k) [3]. Also: Steve Rolfe's audience recording patched Minglewood, Dancin', and The Other One on the SBD [3]
- **gd1979-10-27.sbd.miller.98950.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony TCD5M/UDXL-II) -> Dat (Panasonic SV3800/48k) [4]. Also: Joe B. Jones helped with pitch correction for the Dancin' and Other One fixes [4]
- **gd79-10-27.sbd.clugston.13980.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [9]
- **gd79-10-27.aud-rolfe.warner.19416.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Steve Rolfe; source: Audience Recording [12]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by The Real Cape: [Hippie, Author at The Real Cape - Page 18 of 189](https://therealcape.com/author/admin/page/18/) [31]
- Photo by a Flickr member (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead - 10/27/79 Cape Cod Coliseum, …](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/26759945453/) [32]
- Photo by uncredited: [the page](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/26759945453/) [33]
